info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Education Enrollments Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Status API enables users to retrieve current statuses of education enrollments. It provides essential insights into the enrollment state of students, making it a valuable tool for educational institutions and administrators. This API supports use cases like monitoring enrollment trends, assessing program effectiveness, and facilitating communication with students or stakeholders regarding their enrollment status. By accessing this information, users can enhance decision-making processes and improve operational efficiency within educational settings.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of enrollments. It is useful for checking whether the enrollment process is complete, pending, or if there are any issues that need to be addressed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of enrollments. Ensure that the required parameters are included in the request to obtain the relevant information.
